fields.summary: The owner and the orchestrator (Claude Code in Rex) planned milestone 2 inside Genesis on 2026-10-25, right after milestone 1's import. Decided: milestone 2 is "Genesis runs the work" (layers 3–4), so milestone 3 is built with Genesis orchestrating; milestone 2 is an intent its change sets serve, with done points as child intents verified by Evidence; depends-on means only "can't start before", so the area chain is retired and the areas become a backlog; milestone work is carved out of the area bundles; a write sees the change sets it depends on, change sets land in dependency order, dropped dependencies and cycles are reported, rebasing stays manual; the scope (Claude Code adapter, runs with a built-in ship-change workflow, messages to a running step, interview answers as Decisions, blocked runs that tell the owner) and what is out; shipit stays the agent step; eight change sets, with 1, 2 and 7 written in full first and 3, 4, 5 and 8 proposed with intent only; the owner gave the go-ahead to accept 1, 2 and 7. Every answer was the owner accepting the orchestrator's proposal; the proposals' wording is the orchestrator's.
